note: Every movement Evergreen may plan, with one set of words for each. Units are reps and seconds only. Backpack load is in kilograms: 1 litre of water weighs 1 kg.

movements.name: Sit down and stand up
movements.setup: Stand in front of a sturdy chair, feet hip-width apart.
steps: Sit down to the chair in 3 seconds, arms crossed on your chest.
Touch the seat lightly, don't rest.
Stand up in 1 second.
movements.feel: Front of the thighs and the buttocks.
movements.pass: Buttocks touch the seat each time and you stand all the way up without using your hands.
mistakes: Dropping onto the seat instead of lowering.

movements.name: Squat
movements.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
steps: Push your hips back and bend your knees for 3 seconds.
Stop when your thighs are level with the floor.
Stand up in 1 second.
movements.feel: Front of the thighs and the buttocks.
movements.pass: Thighs reach level with the floor, heels stay down and knees point the same way as the toes.

movements.name: Backpack squat
movements.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, backpack held against your chest.
steps: Hug the backpack to your chest.
Push your hips back and bend your knees for 3 seconds.
Stop when your thighs are level with the floor.
Stand up in 1 second.
movements.feel: Front of the thighs and the buttocks.
movements.pass: Thighs reach level with the floor, heels stay down and the backpack stays against your chest.

movements.name: One-leg sit down to a chair
movements.setup: Stand in front of a sturdy chair on one leg, arms forward.
steps: Lift one foot just off the floor.
Sit down to the chair on the other leg in 3 seconds.
Stand up on the same leg in 1 second.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Front of the thigh and the buttock of the standing leg.
movements.pass: Buttocks touch the seat and you stand back up without the lifted foot touching the floor.

movements.name: Hip lift on the floor
movements.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat and hip-width apart, arms by your sides.
steps: Push through your heels and lift your hips in 1 second.
Hold at the top for 1 second.
Lower in 3 seconds.
movements.feel: Buttocks and back of the thighs.
movements.pass: At the top your shoulders, hips and knees are in one straight line.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
Pushing through the toes instead of the heels.

movements.name: Hip lift with shoulders on the sofa
movements.setup: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the sofa edge, knees bent, feet flat.
steps: Hold the backpack on your hips.
Push through your heels and lift your hips in 1 second.
Hold at the top for 1 second.
Lower in 3 seconds.
movements.feel: Buttocks and back of the thighs.
movements.pass: At the top your shins are upright and your shoulders, hips and knees are in one straight line.
mistakes: Arching the lower back at the top.
Feet too close, so the knees bend past the toes.

movements.name: One-leg hip lift
movements.setup: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat, arms by your sides.
steps: Lift one foot and straighten that leg.
Push through the other heel and lift your hips in 1 second.
Lower in 3 seconds.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Buttocks and back of the thigh of the working leg.
movements.pass: At the top both hips are level and in one straight line with the shoulder and the bent knee.
mistakes: One hip dropping lower than the other.

movements.name: Split squat holding the wall
movements.setup: Stand side-on to a wall, one hand on it, one foot a long step in front of the other.
steps: Lower your back knee towards the floor in 3 seconds.
Stop with the back knee a hand's width above the floor.
Push up in 1 second.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Front of the thigh and the buttock of the front leg.
movements.pass: The back knee stops a hand's width above the floor and the front knee stays over the front foot.

movements.name: Step back and lower
movements.setup: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, hands on hips.
steps: Step one foot back.
Lower the back knee in 3 seconds to a hand's width above the floor.
Push through the front heel and step back up in 1 second.
Change legs each time.
movements.feel: Front of the thigh and the buttock of the front leg.
movements.pass: The back knee stops a hand's width above the floor and you return to standing without a wobble.
mistakes: Short step, so the front knee shoots forward.

movements.name: Step back and lower with the backpack
movements.setup: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, backpack held against your chest.
steps: Hug the backpack to your chest.
Step one foot back and lower the back knee in 3 seconds.
Push through the front heel and step back up in 1 second.
Change legs each time.
movements.feel: Front of the thigh and the buttock of the front leg.
movements.pass: The back knee stops a hand's width above the floor and the backpack stays against your chest.
mistakes: Short step, so the front knee shoots forward.

movements.name: Split squat with the back foot on the sofa
movements.setup: Stand a long step in front of the sofa, the top of your back foot resting on the seat.
steps: Lower your back knee in 3 seconds.
Stop with the front thigh level with the floor.
Push up through the front heel in 1 second.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Front of the thigh and the buttock of the front leg.
movements.pass: The front thigh reaches level with the floor and the front heel stays down.
mistakes: Front foot too close to the sofa.

movements.name: Push the hips back
movements.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees a little bent, hands on the front of your thighs.
steps: Keep your back straight and push your hips back in 3 seconds.
Stop when your upper body is about halfway to level.
Push your hips forward to stand in 1 second.
movements.feel: Back of the thighs and the buttocks.
movements.pass: Your hands slide down to just above the knees, your back stays straight and your knees don't bend further.
mistakes: Bending the knees into a squat.

movements.name: Push the hips back with the backpack
movements.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees a little bent, backpack hanging in front of your thighs.
steps: Hold the backpack by its top handle in both hands.
Keep your back straight and push your hips back in 3 seconds.
Stop when the backpack reaches your knees.
Push your hips forward to stand in 1 second.
movements.feel: Back of the thighs and the buttocks.
movements.pass: The backpack reaches the knees with a straight back, and you finish standing tall.

movements.name: Push the hips back, one foot ahead
movements.setup: Stand with one foot half a step ahead of the other, backpack in both hands.
steps: Put most of your weight on the front foot.
Keep your back straight and push your hips back in 3 seconds until the backpack reaches the front knee.
Stand up in 1 second.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Back of the thigh and the buttock of the front leg.
movements.pass: The backpack reaches the front knee with a straight back and the back foot only rests on its toes.
mistakes: Shifting the weight to the back foot.

movements.name: One-leg reach
movements.setup: Stand on one leg, the other foot just off the floor, arms hanging.
steps: Lean forward from the hips while the free leg goes back in 3 seconds.
Stop when your body and the back leg are near level.
Come back up in 1 second.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Back of the thigh and the buttock of the standing leg.
movements.pass: Your upper body and the back leg form one straight line and the free foot doesn't touch down.

movements.name: Rise onto the toes
movements.setup: Stand with feet hip-width apart, fingertips on a wall for balance.
steps: Rise onto your toes in 1 second.
Hold at the top for 1 second.
Lower in 3 seconds.
movements.feel: Calves.
movements.pass: Heels lift as high as they go each time and come all the way back down.
mistakes: Rolling onto the outer edge of the feet.

movements.name: One-foot rise, hand on the wall
movements.setup: Stand on one foot, one hand on a wall.
steps: Lift one foot.
Rise onto the toes of the other in 1 second.
Lower in 3 seconds.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Calf of the standing leg.
movements.pass: The heel lifts as high as it goes and comes all the way down, with the hand only steadying you.
mistakes: Pushing on the wall to rise.

movements.name: One-foot rise off a book
movements.setup: Stand on one foot with the ball of the foot on a thick book, one hand on a wall.
steps: Let your heel drop below the book edge in 3 seconds.
Rise as high as you can in 1 second.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Calf of the standing leg.
movements.pass: The heel goes below the book edge and then rises above it every time.

movements.name: Push-up against the wall
movements.setup: Stand an arm's length from a wall, hands on it at shoulder height.
steps: Lower your chest to the wall in 3 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Push back in 1 second.
movements.feel: Chest, front of the shoulders and back of the arms.
movements.pass: Your nose comes within a fist of the wall and your hips stay in line with your shoulders and heels.
mistakes: Elbows flaring straight out to the sides.

movements.name: Push-up on the table edge
movements.setup: Hands on the edge of a sturdy table, shoulder-width apart, feet back so your body is straight.
steps: Lower your chest to the table edge in 3 seconds.
Keep your body straight.
Push back up in 1 second.
movements.feel: Chest, front of the shoulders and back of the arms.
movements.pass: Your chest comes within a fist of the edge and your hips don't sag.
mistakes: Elbows flaring straight out to the sides.

movements.name: Push-up on the knees
movements.setup: Hands on the floor under your shoulders, knees on the floor, body straight from knees to head.
steps: Lower your chest to the floor in 3 seconds.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Push back up in 1 second.
movements.feel: Chest, front of the shoulders and back of the arms.
movements.pass: Your chest comes within a fist of the floor and your hips stay in line.

movements.name: Push-up
movements.setup: Hands on the floor under your shoulders, legs straight behind you on your toes.
steps: Lower your chest to the floor in 3 seconds.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Push back up in 1 second.
movements.feel: Chest, front of the shoulders and back of the arms.
movements.pass: Your chest comes within a fist of the floor and your hips stay in line with your shoulders and heels.

movements.name: Push-up with feet on the sofa
movements.setup: Hands on the floor under your shoulders, feet on the sofa seat behind you.
steps: Lower your chest to the floor in 3 seconds.
Keep your body straight.
Push back up in 1 second.
movements.feel: Chest, front of the shoulders and back of the arms.
movements.pass: Your chest comes within a fist of the floor and your hips stay in line.

movements.name: Hips-high push-up
movements.setup: Hands and feet on the floor, hips high so your body makes an upside-down V.
steps: Bend your elbows and lower the top of your head towards the floor in 3 seconds.
Push back up in 1 second.
movements.feel: Shoulders and back of the arms.
movements.pass: The top of your head comes within a fist of the floor between your hands, hips stay high.
mistakes: Hands too close to the feet.

movements.name: Backpack press overhead
movements.setup: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, backpack held by its sides at your chest.
steps: Press the backpack straight up in 1 second until your arms are straight.
Lower it to your chest in 3 seconds.
movements.feel: Shoulders and back of the arms.
movements.pass: At the top your arms are straight beside your ears and your lower back stays flat.
mistakes: Pushing the backpack forward, not up.

movements.name: Slow backpack press overhead
movements.setup: Stand tall, feet hip-width apart, backpack held by its sides at your chest.
steps: Press the backpack up in 1 second.
Hold at the top for 2 seconds.
Lower it to your chest in 4 seconds.
movements.feel: Shoulders and back of the arms.
movements.pass: Arms straight beside the ears for the full 2 seconds and the lower back stays flat.

movements.name: Backpack row
movements.setup: Feet hip-width apart, sit your hips back and lean forward to about 45 degrees with a straight back, backpack hanging from both hands.
steps: Pull the backpack to your lower ribs in 1 second.
Squeeze your shoulder blades for 1 second.
Lower it in 3 seconds.
movements.feel: Upper back and the back of the shoulders.
movements.pass: The backpack touches your lower ribs each time and your back stays straight and still.

movements.name: One-arm row, hand on a chair
movements.setup: One hand on a chair seat, the same-side foot back, back straight and level, backpack in the free hand.
steps: Pull the backpack to your hip in 1 second.
Hold for 1 second.
Lower it in 3 seconds.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Upper back and the back of the shoulder.
movements.pass: The backpack reaches your hip, your elbow passes your back and your shoulders stay level.

movements.name: Slow one-arm row
movements.setup: One hand on a chair seat, back straight and level, backpack in the free hand.
steps: Pull the backpack to your hip in 1 second.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Lower it in 4 seconds.
Do all reps on one side, then the other.
movements.feel: Upper back and the back of the shoulder.
movements.pass: The backpack stays at your hip for the full 2 seconds and your shoulders stay level.

movements.name: Arms up lying face down
movements.setup: Lie face down, arms stretched forward in a Y, thumbs up, forehead on a folded towel.
steps: Lift both arms off the floor in 1 second.
Hold for 1 second.
Lower in 3 seconds.
movements.feel: Upper back and the back of the shoulders.
movements.pass: Both hands lift a fist's height off the floor and your forehead stays down.
mistakes: Lifting the head and chest instead of the arms.

movements.name: Arms up lying face down, with a hold
movements.setup: Lie face down, arms stretched forward in a Y, thumbs up, forehead on a folded towel.
steps: Lift both arms off the floor in 1 second.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Lower in 3 seconds.
movements.feel: Upper back and the back of the shoulders.
movements.pass: Both hands stay a fist's height off the floor for the full 2 seconds.

movements.name: Backpack curl
movements.setup: Stand tall, backpack held by its top handle with both hands, arms straight.
steps: Bend your elbows and lift the backpack to your chest in 1 second.
Lower it in 3 seconds until your arms are straight.
movements.feel: Front of the upper arms.
movements.pass: Your elbows stay at your sides and the backpack goes from straight arms to your chest each time.

movements.name: Opposite arm and leg out, lying on your back
movements.setup: Lie on your back, arms pointing at the ceiling, knees bent at 90 degrees above your hips.
steps: Reach one arm back and the opposite leg out in 3 seconds.
Stop just above the floor.
Bring them back in 1 second.
Change sides each time.
movements.feel: Stomach.
movements.pass: Your lower back stays pressed to the floor and the moving heel stops just above it.
mistakes: Lower back lifting off the floor.
Moving the arm and leg of the same side.

movements.name: Forearm plank
movements.setup: Lie face down, forearms on the floor under your shoulders, on your toes.
steps: Lift your hips so your body is straight from head to heels.
Hold, breathing normally.
movements.feel: Stomach and front of the shoulders.
movements.pass: Shoulders, hips and heels stay in one straight line for the whole time.

movements.name: Forearm plank, elbows further forward
movements.setup: Lie face down on your forearms, on your toes.
steps: Place your elbows a hand ahead of your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is straight.
Hold, breathing normally.
movements.feel: Stomach.
movements.pass: Elbows stay ahead of the shoulders and the body stays in one straight line for the whole time.

movements.name: Side plank on the knees
movements.setup: Lie on your side, elbow under the shoulder, knees bent behind you.
steps: Lift your hips off the floor.
Hold, then do the other side.
movements.feel: Side of the stomach.
movements.pass: Shoulder, hip and knee stay in one straight line for the whole time.

movements.name: Side plank
movements.setup: Lie on your side, elbow under the shoulder, legs straight and stacked.
steps: Lift your hips off the floor.
Hold, then do the other side.
movements.feel: Side of the stomach.
movements.pass: Shoulder, hip and ankle stay in one straight line for the whole time.

movements.name: Opposite arm and leg out, on hands and knees
movements.setup: On hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.
steps: Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back in 1 second.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Bring them back in 2 seconds.
Change sides each time.
movements.feel: Stomach, lower back and buttocks.
movements.pass: Arm and leg reach level with your back and your hips stay square to the floor.

movements.name: March on the spot
movements.setup: Stand tall.
steps: March, lifting each knee to hip height.
Swing your arms.
movements.feel: Front of the hips and the heart rate going up.
movements.pass: Each knee reaches hip height and you keep going for the whole time.
mistakes: Lifting the knees only a little.

movements.name: Quick high knees
movements.setup: Stand tall.
steps: Run on the spot, bringing each knee to hip height.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
movements.feel: Front of the hips and the heart rate going up.
movements.pass: Each knee reaches hip height and you keep going for the whole time.

movements.name: Step up and down
movements.setup: Stand facing a bottom stair or a sturdy step.
steps: Step up with one foot and stand tall on the step.
Step down with the same foot.
Change the leading foot every 10 steps.
movements.feel: Front of the thighs and the heart rate going up.
movements.pass: You stand fully upright on the step each time and keep going for the whole time.
mistakes: Not standing tall at the top.

movements.name: Squat and reach up
movements.setup: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
steps: Squat until your thighs are level with the floor in 2 seconds.
Stand up and reach both arms straight overhead in 1 second.
movements.feel: Thighs, buttocks and shoulders.
movements.pass: Thighs reach level with the floor and your arms finish straight beside your ears.

movements.name: Shadow boxing
movements.setup: Stand with one foot half a step ahead, knees soft, fists by your chin.
steps: Punch straight ahead, one hand then the other.
Turn your back heel with each punch.
Bring each hand back to your chin.
movements.feel: Shoulders, the middle of the body and the heart rate going up.
movements.pass: Each punch reaches a straight arm and the hand comes back to your chin before the next.
